clinical_indication: Enlarged right axillary lymph node, previous biopsy B1, with known right breast cancer; query involvement. Repeat biopsy as per MDM recommendation.

specimens.anatomical_site_name_desc: Breast axilla node core biopsy - RT

findings.finding_summary: Right axillary lymph node core biopsy shows infiltration by invasive carcinoma of no special type (invasive adenocarcinoma NST), no in-situ component identified; ER and PR strongly positive, HER2 negative.

biomarkers.result_value: Allred score = 7 (range 0-8), strongly positive, >66% of tumour cell nuclei reactive, predominantly moderate intensity
Allred score = 8 (range 0-8), strongly positive, >66% of tumour cell nuclei reactive, predominantly strong intensity

report_summary: Right axillary lymph node core biopsy performed for an enlarged node in a patient with known right breast cancer, previously B1. Shows infiltration by invasive carcinoma of no special type (B5b), no in-situ component. ER strongly positive (Allred 7/8), PR strongly positive (Allred 8/8), HER2 negative (IHC score 1+).
